codeReview.summary: Reviewed the worker transcript skeleton and commit diff for plugin zoom fast-track. The implementation wires remote plugin panels into workspace-owned ToggleZoom flow, adds labeled child-target rendering when zoomed, and updates dock position sync to preserve single-instance zoomed panel movement. Added tests in plugin_host plus existing workspace zoom regressions provide coverage for the expected behavior, and no actionable correctness issues were identified in the reviewed changes.

summary: Pass: implementation aligns with the feature contract for workspace-owned plugin zoom integration, labeled child-target zoom rendering, and zoom-preserving dock movement without duplicate panel instances.
